[[Chet Jr.|Chet Jr. IV]] - stepson |status =Deceased |location =[[Vault 33]] |role = |affiliation =[[Vault 33]] |dod = |dod verified= }} '''Chet Jr.''' was the father of [[Chet (TV series)|Chet]] in [[Vault 33]]. ==Background== Chet Jr. died of starvation during the Weevil Famine that struck Vault 33 some years prior to [[Timeline (2250-2300)#2296|2296]].[[Davey (TV series)|Davey]]: ''"You ran a great campaign."''
[[Woody Thomas]]: ''"I know. Must've put ten posters up."''
Davey: ''"Yeah. That's what you got to do. You put a few posters up and let democracy run its course. You know, I ran once. And then that weevil famine came. Lost to none other than Hank MacLean. You know what they say. When things look glum, vote for somebody from Vault 31."''
("[[The Past]]") {{Small|Note: This reference indicates that the Weevil Famine occurred during a prior election cycle in Vault 33.}} His son, [[Chet (TV series)|Chet]], was left scarred by the sight of watching him waste away. In July 2296, [[Steph Harper]]'s newborn son was also christened as Chet Jr., despite Chet's own reservations with the name due to it reminding him of his own father.[[Chet (TV series)|Chet]]: ''"Would you at least consider giving him a name? Because the neighbors have started to call him Chet Jr."''
[[Steph Harper]]: ''"Let's go with that then."''
Chet: ''"Well, see, Chet Jr. was my father's name. It's, uh, sort of a personal area for me, having watched him die of starvation in the Weevil Famine."''
Steph: ''"Chet? Are we having an argument?"''
Chet: ''"Chet Jr. it is."'' ==Appearances== Chet Jr. is mentioned only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|9=201}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series mentioned-only characters]] [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[Category:Vault 33 characters]]
